GOLDEN HOUR FROM THE LEFT: a low sun from the left, warm honey light raking across the route, long soft shadows stretching far to the right, every edge rimmed in molten gold
GOLDEN HOUR FROM THE RIGHT: the sun low on the right, amber light flooding across the landscape, long blue-gold shadows reaching left, each ridge and rim lit with a warm copper glow
GOLDEN HOUR AHEAD: a low sun directly ahead, rich apricot light pouring along the route, shadows streaming straight back, every surface touched with a soft warm-gold shimmer
GOLDEN HOUR FROM BEHIND: the sun low behind, warm golden backlight spilling over the route, long shadows stretching forward, every upper edge caught in a rim of bright amber
GOLDEN HOUR SIDE RAKE: slanting honey-gold light from the upper left, long warm shadows draped across the landscape to the right, the route glittering with a low warm amber path
DAWN OVER THE FAR HILLS: first light rising behind the far hills, rose and pale gold washing the upper sky, the valley below resting in a cool soft blue ambient shadow
EARLY DAWN FROM THE EAST: a gentle rose-gold glow climbing from the east, pale gold light touching the high ground, the lower route still held in a quiet blue-shadow calm
DAWN SIDE LIGHT: pale gold dawn light arriving softly from the right, rose ambient brushing the skyline, the valley floor draped in a delicate cool blue shadow that fades slowly upward
DAWN GLOW BEHIND THE HILLS: warm rose and pale gold light diffusing from behind distant hills, a gentle amber band low on the horizon, the foreground resting in a cool blue ambient haze of shadow
BLUE HOUR WEST BAND: the sun just gone, indigo and violet ambient settling from above, one last warm apricot band glowing low in the west, long cool shadows spreading east across the route
BLUE HOUR DEEP VIOLET: indigo light from overhead, the route bathed in a cool violet ambient, a thin band of warm orange still fading in the west, shadows deepening to a rich blue-purple
BLUE HOUR SIDE FADE: violet and indigo ambient from the upper right, the western edge of the route holding a last warm gold band, shadows pooling to the left in deep cool blue
BLUE HOUR SOFT INDIGO: a deep indigo ambient from above, the route and landscape washed in cool violet, a low warm amber glow persisting in the west, shadows long and blue across every surface
HIGH MOON OVERHEAD: cool silver light from straight overhead, the route pale and glittering, shadows short, sharp-edged and deep blue, every flat surface catching a clean silver ambient sheen
MOONLIT SIDE LEFT: cool silver moonlight arriving from the upper left, the route pale and crisp, hard-edged blue shadows falling to the right, every rim traced in a faint cool silver light
MOONLIT SIDE RIGHT: silver moonlight raking in from the upper right, the landscape pale and still, sharp blue shadows cast hard to the left, the route edged with a clean cool silver rim
MOONLIT ANGLE: the moon high and slightly ahead to the left, cool silver ambient across the route, hard-edged deep blue shadows angling back right, the ground glittering with a pale silver light
LATE AFTERNOON LEFT SLANT: warm slanting light from the left side, amber rays crossing the route, shadows stretching long to the right, every edge caught in a soft golden rim of afternoon light
LATE AFTERNOON RIGHT SLANT: rich warm light slanting in from the right, long shadows reaching left across the landscape, the route edged with a warm amber rim along every raised surface
LATE AFTERNOON WARM SIDE: a broad warm amber light from the left, the route glowing with a honey-toned ambient, long shadows stretching right, every edge kissed with a soft warm rim of gold
SUNSET AFTERGLOW SKY: rose and orange ambient fading upward into the sky, the land below resting in a warm amber shadow, the far hills catching a last glowing band of rose-gold light
SUNSET AFTERGLOW FADE: a soft rose and orange glow diffusing from the west, the landscape wrapped in warm amber shadow, the far ridgeline still holding a faint rose-pink rim of fading light
SUNSET AFTERGLOW WARM LAND: orange and rose ambient settling over the route, the land in a deep warm shadow, the far hills edged with a glowing band of soft rose and copper light
SOFT MORNING SIDE LEFT: gentle cool-gold side light arriving from the left, clean cool shadows falling softly to the right, the route surface sparkling with a scattered dew glitter in the low light

SOFT MORNING CLEAN LIGHT: a quiet early side light from the right, cool clean shadows stretching gently left, the ground ahead catching a soft dew glitter, the whole scene wrapped in a pale cool-gold ambient
